name: Giving Money To The Church
overview: Scripture teaches that giving money to the church is an act of honoring God by offering the firstfruits of our increase, as shown in Proverbs 3:9. Malachi 3:10 encourages believers to bring their tithes faithfully to the storehouse, promising God’s abundant blessings in return. Jesus warns in Matthew 6:24 that one cannot serve both God and wealth, emphasizing the need for wholehearted devotion. Furthermore, Luke 6:38 assures that generous giving results in receiving blessings in measure pressed down and overflowing, highlighting the reciprocal nature of faithful stewardship.
